releases.displayName: Important update about Ova Magica's console release

items.text: Hello everyone,

As we count down the days until Ova Magica's console release, we have good and bad news. Originally, we had hoped to announce this alongside the console launch, but unfortunately it looks like timelines won't align to make it possible. To start with the good news, Ova Magica will be coming natively to Switch 2 - not just through backwards compatibility with Switch 1. We originally did not plan for this, given the game's development started much before Nintendo had officially announced the console. Supporting the new hardware required significant changes to our console codebase for native Switch 2 support.

As a result, we've needed a little more time to finish and polish the other console versions. While we are near the finish line, we want every console version to launch in the best possible state. and ensure stability across all of Ova Magica's announced console platforms.

We will now be planning a release date on 8th September 2026 for Nintendo Switch, Nintendo Switch 2, PlayStation, and Xbox. All kickstarter requests will still be honored. Similarly, physical editions will still ship to all backers and also enter retail sale soon after launch, more news of which will be delivered soon. Thank you for your continued support.
Top Hat Studios & ClaudiaTheDev

releases.displayName: Important Update - Upcoming Major Announcement and More!

notes.title: Hello to our amazing Ova Magica community 💚

items.text: Over the past months, we’ve been working incredibly hard on Ova Magica and its full release.

A huge part of that effort has been localization — translating over 300,000 words into multiple languages (Simplified Chinese, German, French, Spanish, and Japanese) — which turned out to be far more time-intensive than we expected.
On top of that, we’ve also been preparing for a console release. It’s been a big journey for our small team!
First of all: thank you 🙏

Your patience, support, and understanding truly mean the world to us. As a very small team working on a big game without the resources of a large studio, things sometimes take a bit longer — and we’re incredibly grateful that you’ve stuck with us along the way.

notes.title: With this small update, we have 2 important things to share!

items.text: 1) Upcoming Announcement 📢
You can expect a MAJOR public announcement at the very end of May 🎉
We can’t share all the details just yet — but we promise it’ll be worth the wait!
2) Price Adjustment 💰
Starting April 24th, the price of Ova Magica will increase to:
$29.99 / €29.99 (and equivalent in other currencies).
This reflects the final game price, so it will not increase again.

notes.title: We also want to give a small 1.0 Beta recap

items.text: The 1.0 Beta is now complete, and the full release of Ova Magica will bring a wide range of improvements, quality-of-life updates, and brand-new content.
The balancing and QoL improvements were especially praised by Beta players, and many of these changes stem directly from player feedback and reviews.
Here is a super rough overview of just some of the most anticipated changes for 1.0 to make the game feel and play better:
✨ Quality of Life Improvements + Balancing
No more fainting at midnight
Longer days
Reworked energy system (less punishing, more fun)
Rebalanced economy (shops, buildings, and materials) to reduce grind
…and much more! (yes, the whole list of all improvements is quite long)
💚 New Content & Features
Completion of all major quests, tournaments, and heart events
Romance + Marriage system
A brand-new Blob World featuring an extensive quest
Blob fusion
…and much more!
Once again, thank you for being part of the Ova Magica journey 💚
— Claudia and Top Hat Studios

Below are SPOILERS, so stop reading here if you prefer to play the new content blind and figure out how to unlock the new features for yourself.
Venture with Lapis into the blob world and discover the secret of the legendary blob fossil egg! The blob world comes as always with new blobs to collect.
Fill the level 4 heart fully for Lapis and Lazuli to unlock their new friendship event. The event is a special “duo event”. Follow the quests of the event to gain access to the Prehistoric Badlands.
If you are still missing some seasonal or festival items you can now skip quickly to the required season:
Re-visit the Keeper of Time. The blob gifts you a legendary egg and offers you to progress time to the next season.

How to unlock: Available the day after completing Jade's level 4 heart event (in which you meet the Keeper of Time first time). Interact with your bed or tent and you will see an additional choice "Dream until next day".
All 13 befriendable Npcs are now playable until level 5.
How to unlock: Progress the friendship of all Npcs to level 5.
An x-ray device which can store blob eggs and show you their content before hatching them.
How to unlock: complete the Prehistoric Badlands blob world.
Based on feedback that some players experienced motion sickness when playing Ova Magica.
There are now 2 new settings in the pause menu which hopefully will prevent or reduce it:
Disable Camera Smoothing: Removes all camera “after smoothing /motion” which can greatly help when the motion sickness occurs mainly when moving the player character and rotating the camera.
Battle Camera Setting: You can choose between the options “Dynamic (Default)”, “Less Rotation” and “Static” to help reduce motion sickness during battles.
Based on players' feedback that switching blobs for farming, battling and other tasks was tedious.
Flint now sells the “Team Terminal” blueprint. Use it to register blob teams and swap between them quickly without having to go into blob barns and navigate the UI each time.
Based on players' feedback to see more information what the skills and abilities of blobs do.
Descriptions for blob skills and abilities can now be displayed in several “UI locations” with the "Skill Info" button.

You can now select the new choice “View museum inventory” when interacting with the donation box. The museum inventory lists already donated items and shows how many items are still missing in the botanic garden, dining hall and aquarium area of the museum.
Based on feedback that players want instantly transfer items from the inventory to the magical storage without having to navigate through all the individual items.
With the new “Quick Transfer” button you can now move all items from your inventory to the magical storage which are already stored in the magical storage too.
Note: the quick transfer does not occupy new free slots in the magical storage, if the max allowed amount of 999 for an item slot is reached
Based on players' feedback that it's tedious to walk back to your tent/house to save the game.
All fast travel points can now also be used to save the game (except in the Clover Town area during festivals).
The display of the old “Grade” (A-F) on blob skills was removed. Instead the status effects and stat value changes (attack, defense, speed) are now displayed for more infos.

The “Skill Grade” was an early concept that was not yet properly implemented. During several tests in Early Access, it ended up not working well with the battle balancing. A more “complex” system isn't always good and can cause confusion, so we decided to remove it and not force something into the game that doesn't really work well.

First we want to share the updated roadmap with you! The current update is the 0.8 version.
⚠️Attention: Below the roadmap pic are descriptions with SPOILERS of the new content! Stop reading after the roadmap if you do not want to be spoilered.

The 7th blob world which was initially not planned but added as Kickstarter stretchgoal was for now sadly removed from the roadmap to not delay the 1.0 release further. One of the main reasons is that we just need more time to polish the 6 main blob worlds and add still missing features to them.

We plan adding the 7th blob world in an update after full release also based on your ideas and feedback for possible new blobs + quests. We want to apologize for the change and hope for your understanding.
In the new blob world you can find several new blobs like the Tiger, Red Panda, Peacock and more. It also comes with new resources, like the Mithril ore vein, and the greenhouse blueprint.
In the greenhouse you can grow different crops all year round. Comes with a sprinkler and a thermostat to set the season.

Inside are signs of volcanic activity. This could also explain the hot spring that Garnet discovered and that powers the Spa. In the cave you can find new blobs, coal resources and the very rare Emberpetal which can revive a fainted blob in battle.

You can leave a blob in the Blob Paradise to train it. The maximum possible level is determined by your tournament rank.
The Blob Paradise you can also purchase blueprints for devices which can train your blob stats. These are the blob wheel (Speed), trampoline (Defense) and training target (Attack).
NEW ITEMS: HEALTH + ENERGY BOOSTER
Boosters permanently increase a blob's health or energy which helps to level up your blobs. This items are rare and can be found mainly in blob world chests.
Test your blob trainer skills in the Mithril Cup tournament! (unlocked with all NPCs friendship being level 4)
Improved Farming Tool Controls
Can now hold the key/button for most farming actions instead having to press the key again.
Affected actions: watering crops, planting seeds, hoeing ground, harvesting crops

Crops and other items(for example dropped in the shooting start event or by wild blobs) do now not disappear when leaving an area. You can go inside your blob barn and return to the farm without worrying about the items being gone like before.
Not collected items are still removed on the next day.
UI for Blob Placing can now also access blobs from the barn

Mainly the auto-petter and new blob training devices are affected. When in a blob barn you can now access blobs of your barn and team. This avoids having to put a blob in your team when you want to place it on an Auto-Petter or training device in the barn.

We got a lot if feedback the current 2% egg drop rate from wild blobs is too low. This won't change and it is intended for blob eggs to feel rare and special. But there is now a new item in-game which will help you to 100% get your desired wild blob egg:

During the shooting star event in addition to copper ores now also "Star Shards" fall from the sky. They can be melted with the furnace into a "Wishing Star". Using the Wishing Star on a wild blob will guarantee it 100% dropping an egg after the battle (careful: do not waste it on bosses).

Hi, Claudia here!
Monday starts productive with an update and it's a big one! This update has several changes to gameplay, all based on the most requested feedback 💚

As devs the team is a bit anxious with changing things because it's always a risk some players enjoyed it the way it was and prefer no change. But we decided to take the risk based on the feedback players provided. Ova Magica is still in Early Access so this changes do not need to be final and the team continues to improve the game.
You can get all changes in your current save file, no need to restart if you do not want to.
Make sure to update to 0.625 version: If Steam doesn't do the update automatic close and restart Steam.
On Steam Deck sometimes the Deck doesn't start games after updates, in this case restart the Steam Deck.)
FEEDBACK: First blob world is too hard
Lowered Mystical Forest wild blobs level slightly (stage 1: level 12-15 instead before 15-18)
After visiting Mystical Forest blob world there will be a gift in the mailbox to help with it (when you return to your farm)
In the blob world the UI now also displays the wild blob level of the current stage (see upper left corner) - so you can better estimate if your blobs are strong enough
FEEDBACK: Blob stat leveling takes too long
Doubled(!) experience when using a skill in battle. BUT:
A skill can now level up only once per battle to avoid endless leveling in a single battle (stat values are now leveled at the end of battle for each skill being at 100% exp)
FEEDBACK: Things are too expensive
Reduced most building prices (Charoi)
Reduced blob world rune costs (Harold)

Reduced prices vendors: Blob Eggs: 3000 (Before 3500): Blueprint Makers + co: 3000 (Before 5000): Blueprint Useful: 2500 (Before 4000): Blueprint Decorative: 1250 (Before 2500): Blob Toys: 1500 (Before 3000): Recipes: 1500 (Before 2500): Outfits: 1500 (Before 3500): Accessoires: 1250 (before: 2500): Big Blob Barn: 10000 (Before: 15000)
Season has now 20 days instead of 12.
So the main reasons why players didn't like 4 days weeks was not having enough time between the festivals for other activities and feeling rushed (+it also being a lot different from most farm sims).

BUT increasing week length was not a good option because: At the beginning of a week a lot respawns like foraging items (herbs, mushrooms, flowers, sand, oysters and and and) and also the mine ores. So increasing the week length would result in waiting longer for the new items and would have negative effects on the gameplay - it was no option.

So there are now 2 additional weeks per season without festivals which increases the season length from 12 to 20 days and is now closer to the "usual" farm sim experience. Now you have some extra days to do all the things you want + more times to grow crops and profit in one season before crops wither on season change.

To all who liked the fast pace with every week having a festival: Don't worry! For full game there will be still smaller events in this weeks so they wont get boring too💚! Just not in a festival style but smaller things (as example a special merchant visiting Clover Town). Feel free to share your ideas for this smaller events!
(Note: When loading your save file you will start in the week of the same festival before - so week 1-> week 1, week 2-> week 3, week 3-> week 5)
VARIOUS IMPROVEMENTS + BUGFIXES
added a 3rd skill to Jade’s blob Clara
swapped "Sleep" and "Save Game" choice when interacting with bed/tent to avoid sleeping by accident.
fixed missing pumpkin seeds in Jades store
fixed rain sound being also played in blob world when visiting on a rainy day
fixed timer not running in stacking ring game
fixed that empty steamboard and watering can were refilled when moving to magical storage
fixed strength bar not hiding after canceling hammer mini game with blobs
fixed sound settings not affecting egg logo animation sound in title screen
Thank you for reading so far and we hope this update will improve your gameplay experience 💚! The team will continue working hard towards the next major content update and more feedback + bug fixes.
Some of you also asked how they can support us. Here are some things you can do:
report bugs and feedback in the Steam forums or Discord
help other players with questions in case you know the reply
share Ova Magica with your friends, on social media or create a video/lets play
one of the most important: If you enjoy the game please leave a review. We are a small slowly growing indie team without a huge budget and reviews help us immensly to get some more visibility.
We hope you enjoy playing further! See you until next update💚

notes.title: We created some new Blobs for you♥

items.text: Red Panda and Platypus
Robo Blob
Luck Blob
In February I (Claudia) worked on numerous improvements and features for the barns!

In contrast to a previously fixed and expandable building, blob barns of various sizes are now available as a blueprint in the workbench! Which means what? You can place as many as you want and where you want!
To make it easier for you to find a particular barn, you can now also change the icon. Do you have any particular icon suggestions♥?
A big change from before, and something not found in many farming games, is that you can now decorate your barns just like the house by placing items over the workbench!
You can place functional items, like a feeding station, but also decorative items. Your Blobs will feel happier if a barn matches their preferences.

I also implemented blob pooping :-D When Blobs are fed, they will poop overnight. Keep the barn clean, otherwise your blobs won't feel comfortable. You can remove the poop with a shovel (this consumes stamina).

It is even easier when you unlock the blueprint for a litter box (several sizes can be found). Blobs then make their poop in it and you can easily empty the container in one go without using up stamina and time. Also a blobs mood doesn't get affected by poops in a litter box (so you avoid to having to empty it daily).
And what do you do with the poop? You can use it as fertilizer, for example. One idea from the community is a compost pile that produces fertilizer over several days. What do you think of this idea?
Some blobs produce items overnight in a blob barn. A new addition is that the pig blob produces meat. Do not ask about the logic, we do not slaughter blobs;-P!

For this they must be fed and their mood must not be bad. If its mood is at the highest level, it may happen that a blob will produce a very special item( secret:-) ). Also blobs need to be in good mood to breed and the highest mood guarantees a better result.
Several factors influence the happiness of a blob (Icons from left to right):
Barn decoration: When a barn is decorated with things a blob likes, its mood is higher
Temperature: If the temperature is too different from the one a blob wants, it will be unhappy (see more below)
Barn Cleanness: Each poop in the blob barn reduced the blob mood. Poops in the litter box, do not affect mood
Affection: Petting a bob raises the mood and a blob is sad when it gets neglected for too long

Different blobs have different preferences for temperature. Some like it especially warm, others cold. The mood of a blob is better the closer the temperature is to its preference. If the temperature difference is too great, a blob is unhappy and will not produce items.

The temperature in the barn depends on the seasons. However, you can influence it with items, such as an air conditioner. Be sure to keep blobs with similar temperature preferences together in a barn.

In the video, the player checks the temperature of the barn (upper left corner in the UI- still WIP), then the mood of the cow blobs. Then they place an air conditioner, which changes the temperature from warm to comfortable, and the mood of the two cow blobs rises♥
You can now also fish for shrimp and use them to cook several dishes.
Some of you may have noticed the new beach texture in the video. Several of you found the old beach too colorful, so the texture has now been changed♥ Again thank you for your feedback on this!

When you breed blobs you have a very small chance for a especially strong result due to mutations(comparable to shiny Pokemon). I am still searching for a good name and also experimenting with effects. I tried a rainbow effect but i am not happy yet (it's maybe too bold and "agressive"). But still wanted to share with you the first steps♥
Our artist Ichigo*Ranch also created new swim/beach wear potraits for Lapis, Opal And Jasper!

Thanks for reading so far! Actually, I wanted to introduce you in this update some of the numerous NPCs of Clover Town on which we have worked continuously over the past months. However, the update is now already quite, so I save that for the next update.
The team wishes you a good start into march. Until next time♥!

releases.displayName: November and end of Halloween update! Meet Coral, new blobs, and more!

items.text: We are working hard to bring a variety of different blobs already in the Beta. In October, these three new blobs were created: Hog Blob, Dessert Blob and Beach Blob. See them below in that order!
Which one is your fav♥?

Our artist Ichigo has also finished the portrait for Coral! Coral is Pearl's younger sister. She is the leader of the adventurers club and has a strong and fierce personality! To match her personality, her own personal blob is a Cheetah!
We also worked on the adventurers club interior which is also an orphanage! The members are one big family and the children love to listen to the stories of the adventurers.

We finally got around to pulling the character creation interface out of prototype status! The base UI is ready, but we are still working on adding more colors, outfits, accessories and styles for hair, eyes and beard. There will also be an option to choose your own color and not only the preset ones!

In the video below you can get a first impression of the character creation. And don't worry all the options are not gender locked! Also the current colors are a small selection for testing, there will be of course more colors available♥
When you have any ideas or wishes for a hair styles or outfits, please let us know in the comments♥!
We also try to offer also a variety of hair styles for textured hair! Here are some of them:

Until now, you were dropped into the middle of the story in the game. In October we worked mainly on the game intro! You arrive in Clover Town and of course you get to choose your first Blob! Here are a few impressions (but we do not want to spoil too much, so there is only a small insight)!
Halloween might have come and again a few weeks ago, but did you that the citizens of Clover Town also celebrate the spooky season? Have a look at their festivities!
As always, thank you for reading! If you like what you see and you haven't yet, be sure to wishlist the game to be able to support us at launch!
